files.file: Main page component: Displays valuation metrics via two full-width panels (Summary and Range) and two tabs (Time Series and Risk Premium) with PageThemeProvider (accent: #f59e0b) and tab navigation
Barrel export: Exports main Valuation component, all types from types.ts, and all constants from constants.ts
Type definitions: ValuationMetric, ValuationIndex, TimePeriod, ValuationSummaryRow, ValuationRangeRow, ValuationTimeSeriesPoint, ValuationTimeSeries
Configuration: METRIC_LABELS, INDEX_GROUPS (8 groups), AVAILABLE_INDICES, AVAILABLE_METRICS, TIME_PERIODS, DEFAULT_INDEX/METRIC/TIME_PERIOD, PERCENTILE_COLORS, PERCENTILE_LABELS
React Query hook: Fetches valuation data via useQuery with queryKey 'valuation-data', returns data/isLoading/error/refetch with 5-minute stale time

Heatmap component: Displays latest percentile for 7 metrics across all indices; expandable (5 rows default); sticky headers; color-coded percentiles (red=90th, orange=75th, gray=50th, green=25th, emerald=10th); div_yield inverted

Drilldown component: Shows current valuation vs historical percentile ranges for selected index; grouped dropdown by INDEX_GROUPS; displays latest %-ile, latest value, p10-p90 columns; shows "pending" for indices without data

Chart component: Historical valuation metric as time series with ±1σ to ±2σ bands (p10-p90); dual-index comparison mode (ratio calculation); 4 dropdowns (Index1, Index2, Metric, Period); Recharts ComposedChart; dynamic x-axis tick interval

Chart component: Two charts (Equity Risk Premium and Credit Risk Premium); ERP = S&P 500 earnings yield - 10Y Treasury; Credit = IG and HY spreads from FRED; percentile bands (p10-p90); time window selector (5Y/10Y/20Y/Max); custom tooltips with percentile ranks

Managed by useSelectTracking hook, key 'selected-index', default 'S&P 500', passed to ValuationRangePanel and filters data
useState toggle, controls row expansion (5 default to all rows)
useState, default first available index, controls primary chart data
useState, default 'None', enables ratio mode when not 'None'
useState, default 'trailing_pe', controls which metric is charted
useState, default '10Y', filters data by time window (1Y/5Y/10Y/20Y/Max)

data_flow.flow: 1. Valuation.tsx calls useValuationData() → fetches /v1/valuation/data 2. Data includes summary (40+ indices), ranges (8 indices), time_series (3 indices × 3 metrics) 3. data_as_of registered via useYangDataAsOf('valuation', data?.data_as_of) 4. ValuationSummaryPanel receives data.summary 5. ValuationRangePanel receives data.ranges[selectedIndex] and availableIndices 6. ValuationTimeSeriesTab receives data.time_series

1. RiskPremiumTab calls useQuery with queryFn getRiskPremiumData 2. Fetches /v1/risk-premium/data from portal-proxy 3. Data includes ERP data and Credit (IG/HY) spreads 4. data_as_of registered via useYangDataAsOf('risk_premium', riskPremiumData?.data_as_of) 5. Two charts render with percentile bands calculated from thresholds

1. User selects index from grouped dropdown in ValuationRangePanel 2. onIndexChange calls setSelectedIndex (useSelectTracking) 3. ValuationRangePanel receives new data.ranges[selectedIndex] 4. Panel updates to show ranges for new index

1. User changes Period dropdown in ValuationTimeSeriesTab 2. getFilteredData() calculates startDate based on selectedPeriod 3. Chart re-renders with filtered data points 4. Percentiles recalculated dynamically from visible data 5. X-axis tick interval adjusted based on data point count

1. User selects Index2 != 'None' in ValuationTimeSeriesTab 2. isRatioMode = true 3. getFilteredData() calculates ratio for each date: data1.value / data2.value 4. Chart title changes to "Index1 / Index2 - Metric Ratio" 5. Panel help text explains higher ratio = Index1 more expensive

error_states.error: isLoading: Shows LoadingSpinner centered with page header

!hasData: Shows message about missing time series data, lists available indices and metrics, hints for ratio mode
error || !riskPremiumData: Shows error message with data source path and error details

performance_notes.note: Data fetching: useValuationData uses React Query with 5-minute stale time (global config), automatic retry, refetch on focus/reconnect. No explicit cache duration override in hook.

Time series filtering: getFilteredData() in ValuationTimeSeriesTab recalculates on every render when period changes. Percentile calculation is O(n log n) due to sort, acceptable for <5000 data points.
Ratio mode: Ratio calculation uses Map lookup for O(1) date matching. Filters to only valid dates with both values present.
Panel expansion: ValuationSummaryPanel only renders visible rows (max 5 or all when expanded), reducing DOM size. Sticky headers use z-index layering for scroll performance.

Risk Premium tooltips: Percentile rank calculated on every tooltip via calculatePercentileRank() helper. Overhead acceptable for ~500 data points, but could be memoized if rendering performance becomes issue.
Charts: Recharts ResponsiveContainer handles resize. X-axis tick interval dynamically adjusted (shows 1 per year for 20Y+, every tick for 1Y) to avoid crowding.

styling_notes.note: Theme: PageThemeProvider applies accentColor #f59e0b (amber). Standard Tailwind dark theme with white/opacity variants.
Percentile colors: Consistent across all components (red=90th, orange=75th, gray=50th, green=25th, emerald=10th). Colors support both text and background with opacity.
Tables: Fixed layout, sticky headers, hover effects on rows. Metric names sticky left on horizontal scroll (ValuationSummaryPanel, ValuationRangePanel).
Charts: Max heights defined (300px ERP/Credit, 400px Time Series), scrollbar hidden on tables, ResponsiveContainer handles remaining space.
Utilities: Uses cn() from @/lib/utils for conditional class merging (from clsx/classnames pattern).

dependencies_external.dependency: useQuery for getValuationData and getRiskPremiumData, with global stale time 5 minutes
ComposedChart, LineChart, Line, Area, XAxis, YAxis, CartesianGrid, Tooltip, ResponsiveContainer, ReferenceLine for all chart rendering
TrendingUp, Clock, TriangleAlert for page header and tab icons

backend_integration.service: Endpoint: GET /v1/valuation/data Response: ValuationDataResponse with summary (40+ indices), ranges (8 indices), time_series (3 indices × 3 metrics) Data source: s3://opal-data-portal-v2/json/valuation/valuation_data.json Update frequency: Infrequent, 60-minute cache recommended

Endpoint: GET /v1/risk-premium/data Response: Risk premium data with ERP (S&P 500 earnings yield - 10Y Treasury) and Credit spreads (IG/HY from FRED) Data source: s3://opal-data-portal-v2/json/valuation/risk_premium_data.json Update frequency: Daily or as FRED updates
